findings.title: The required final independent review is not assigned to the requested reviewer profile
findings.detail: Task 4.3 requires an independent final-head review of every Done dimension, but names no reviewer profile or distinct-model attestation. The design likewise says only ‘fresh independent review’ (design.md:49). The configured lifecycle selects Sol Medium as executor and Luna High as reviewer (docs/engineering-lifecycle.md:139-143), and this review request explicitly requires the distinct configured LunaHigh reviewer. Without recording that assignment and proof, the planned gate could be treated as satisfied by an unverified or non-distinct review. This is a planning/evidence omission, not a request to bypass any protected approval.
findings.minimal_fix: Update task 4.3/design evidence requirements to name the configured LunaHigh reviewer and require final-head review evidence that the reviewer is distinct from the executor; retain all owner judgements, forge approvals, and protected gates.

dimensions.name: Acceptance criteria
dimensions.evidence: The first-slice registration, connected-user repository runners, scoped numeric-ID joins, and committed Lighthouse adoption are specified; broader capacity/usage is explicitly deferred.

dimensions.name: Implementation completeness
dimensions.evidence: Tasks 1–4 cover host, GitHub, presentation, verification, and integration; no implementation is claimed.

dimensions.name: Tests
dimensions.evidence: The plan specifies authority-intersection, session cancellation, concurrency, bounds, hostile Git config, source coverage, and browser tests.

dimensions.name: Quality checks
dimensions.evidence: Full npm verification and hosted CI are planned in design.md:49 and tasks.md:24; no checks are represented as run at this plan head.

dimensions.name: Security
dimensions.evidence: Owner and connected-user authorities are separate; the plan specifies cancellation, bounded local input, hermetic tokenless Git reads, output redaction, and no credential fallback.

dimensions.name: Architecture / design conformance
dimensions.evidence: The proposed observer-only slice aligns with ADR-0006 and existing Workspace seams; implementation conformance remains unverified.

dimensions.name: Documentation
dimensions.evidence: Task 4.2 requires architecture, README, and configuration documentation updates.

dimensions.name: Product / spec consistency
dimensions.evidence: The proposal cites accepted product nodes and keeps future health, capacity, usage, and reservations outside this first milestone.

dimensions.name: Evidence
dimensions.evidence: The source preflight is explicitly operator-read-only, not product acceptance; actual connected-user GitHub observations and final CI remain future evidence.

dimensions.name: Human review
dimensions.evidence: Final review of all Done dimensions is planned, but the requested distinct LunaHigh reviewer profile and distinctness evidence are not specified (R57-3).

dimensions.name: Known limitations
dimensions.evidence: Unobserved process health and deferred capacity/usage are explicit; actual desktop confirmation qualifies #49 only, and phone rehearsal is owner-deferred.
